ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts of money involved and the individuals and organizations that have been accused of wrongdoing.
questions: How much money is involved in the child care fraud scheme?
Who are the key players in the scheme?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will be key to uncovering the full extent of the child care fraud scheme. By tracking the financial transactions and identifying the individuals and organizations involved, we can gain a better understanding of how the scheme worked and who was involved.
